title: Build the Eneo module kit
description:
Build the starter for Eneo modules: a FastAPI BFF package with the module contract, a React + Astryx UI package, and
a template app that new modules copy.

## Read first
- `README.md`, `docs/design.md`, `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-kit-plan.md`.

## Scope
This repository only. Code is copied from `eneo-ai/eneo-mod-speech-to-text` at commit `f81a7dd`; that repository is
never changed from here.

## Order
Phase 0 → Phase 1 (BFF) and Phase 2 (UI, first part) → Phase 3 (template) → Phase 4 (session client, after
speech-to-text's Phase 1) → Phase 5 (integration and release). `br ready --json` gives the next bead.

## Success Criteria
- A module copied from `template/` signs in through Eneo's handoff, calls Eneo through the deny-by-default proxy and
  runs as one container on port 3001.
- Both packages are released as 0.1.0 and install into a clean consumer.
- No speech-to-text feature, route or copy is in the packages.

title: Owner: packages public or private, the npm scope, a licence
description:
## Read first
- `docs/design.md`: section 7.

## Decisions
1. Packages public (npm `@eneo-ai/module-kit`, PyPI `eneo-module-bff`) or private? Default: public.
2. Does `eneo-ai` own the `@eneo-ai` scope on npm? If not, which name?
3. A licence for this repository (it has none; the module repositories have none either).
4. `react-router` for the template. Default: yes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Each answer is recorded in a comment here; a non-default answer is written into `docs/design.md`.

comments.author: sonnet-kit
comments.text: Design finding (code left as the plan gives it; needs an owner/lead decision before Phase 3 and before STT adopts the kit). create_app registers the SPA fallback GET /{path:path} (and, per 1.5, the /api/eneo/{path:path} catch-all) itself, so any route a module declares AFTER calling create_app is shadowed. Verified: with static_dir set, @app.get('/api/mine') added after create_app answers 404 {'detail':'Not Found'} (the fallback raises 404 for api/*), while a POST at the same path works (fallback is GET only). Without static_dir GET routes work; module routes under /api/eneo/ are shadowed by the proxy catch-all either way (see comment on .6). deps.py's own docstring says a module declares its routes at import time before an app exists, i.e. on an APIRouter, but create_app has no parameter to take one, and app.include_router(router) after create_app has the same ordering problem. Smallest fix: create_app(..., routers: Sequence[APIRouter] = ()) included before the proxy router and serve_web. Alternative: serve the fallback from a 404 exception handler instead of a route. Template task 3.2 (routes added after create_app, plus the route-walking test) will hit this immediately.
